scope: Exact development-only basic action interfaces, palette UI, shared helpers, EchoAction and ten explicitly separated optional extensions. No arbitrary action subclasses or complete registration aggregators are classified.
evidence_limits: Target membership is source presence across the twenty immutable Git witnesses, not a claim that an independent feature combination compiles or runs.
Feature IDs other than the existing echo_action are proposed ownership names; this ledger does not register flags or modify the catalog.
Source blob hashes, SHA-256 and raw byte counts are one-time migration/equivalence witnesses. Production rendering must read the authored core tree, not historical source snapshots or Git commits.
All new action-family flags disabled must omit every listed file and its registrations, hooks and feature assets. A file owner never implies that every optional member belongs to that owner.
Shared helpers use real-consumer OR inclusion, not a generic helper flag or their package name. Outside lexical consumers are explicitly unresolved where their functional owners were not reviewed.
Internal import and lexical SFM-name lists are dependency clues, not a complete symbol-resolved Java dependency graph; same-package and fully-qualified references must also be guarded.
The primary palette was inspected at contracts, imports, optional interfaces and selected lifecycle/render/call seams; this is not a complete semantic audit of all 2457 lines.
Authorization-service call dependencies were inspected; this ledger is not a complete security audit and must not widen principal, consent or server authority.

client_actions.contract: Human action contract, availability/context/component feedback, client-only registry and Brigadier list/help/invoke. Does not imply palette, machine invocation, workspace, history or control transport.

command_palette.contract: Global palette UI, opening/key entry point, typed completion and captured candidate operations. Theme and keyboard dependencies exist even in the older eight development witnesses; unsupported absence fails closed until a fallback is authored and tested.

echo_action.contract: One identical echo implementation exists in all ten development witnesses. Reconcile registrations/localization/compilation before widening the existing registered support.

client_program_actions.contract: Five principal-aware machine descriptor/context/handler/authorization/dispatcher paths, not basic human actions. Effective permission remains fail closed.

structured_action_results.contract: Bounded Gson JSON object result envelope, independent of SFMValue schemas and programmatic permission descriptors.

keyboard_profiles.contract: Two reviewed keyboard provenance/keycap paths only; the complete keybinding subsystem lies outside this ledger.

command_history.contract: One reviewed parsed history/ranking helper; current SFMCommandFrontierAnalysis dependency requires the typed palette unit until consolidation proves a narrower dependency.

context_actions.contract: One reviewed live panel/palette continuation and optional choice members. The continuation genuinely imports workspace runtime; no workspace-disabled implementation is witnessed.

integration_gates.requirement: Classify each field, factory, type import and setup call by its real owner. The aggregators register terminal/theme/history/panel/control/packet and other subclasses, not just the palette.

Guard SFMKeyMappings.COMMAND_PALETTE_KEY, event registration, localization, editor-open context, mixin accessors, EditBox adapters, ScissorStack and direct theme/keyboard services with exact owners and target adapters.
Author and validate imports, fields, constructor shapes, implements clauses and calls at each mixed-member anchor. Do not copy the primary class unchanged into every feature/target combination.

Reject unsupported partial feature combinations until source/registration/resource closure and compilation prove them. All-off release output must preserve released behavior; full witnessed development output must preserve current source semantics.
Resolve actual outside consumer ownership before using helper OR inclusion for broader feature combinations. Pure ID/icon contracts must not force workspace/theme runtimes.

The source witness supports an identical class on ten targets; the existing registered echo_action supports only 1.19.2. Check all registration/localization/compile hooks before changing the support declaration.
SFMClientCommandInsertion is also used by shortcut drafts. Its inclusion may be shared with the reviewed keyboard owner rather than unconditionally forcing the palette.

notes: Exactly the same blob in all ten development witnesses and absent in all release witnesses.
Existing echo_action feature declaration currently names only 1.19.2; do not expand target support before reconciling registration, localization and compilation.
The class only requires basic human action contracts and existing localization. It does not require command_palette, machine descriptors, client control, terminal or consent.
